canonicalEvidence: Released dialogue: 2525 runs downtown from Venice; Ocean Park and Main.
News dialogue: bus entered at the Lincoln on-ramp, then exited onto Western southbound.
Mac directs the bus onto the unused 105; later news explicitly recaps the 10, city streets, 105, and LAX.
excludedProductionGeography: Early 105 shots stand in for the 10.
Shoreline Drive/Ocean Boulevard in Long Beach stand in for Western Avenue.
Pico/West Boulevard and Athens Way/Imperial are production anchors, not a verified continuous link between Western and the 105.
The 105-to-northbound-110 jump ramp is not substituted for a westbound route to LAX.
Mojave Airport explosion footage does not move the story away from LAX.
routeAudit.geometry: MultiLineString: short eastbound Ocean Park scene; 10 freeway corridor; short southbound Western corridor; 105 westbound corridor. No invented surface-road connectors or airport taxiway loop.
